content: Kernel playground convention (KernelBench, tensormux write-kernel-test-plan, cuda-vs-rocm-kernels): CPU/simple reference implementation -> device implementation -> correctness comparison harness -> microbenchmark driver, per-op directory layout; test plan covers numerical precision, boundary shapes, layout variants; correctness gate must precede perf measurement; ROCm ships hipBench C++17 library with parameter-axis sweeps for HIP microbenchmarks.
